title: Franchise Page Hero Gradient

acceptanceCriteria.description: Gradient applied when brandingColor exists (5-8% opacity, fades to transparent)
No gradient when brandingColor is absent
Gradient is purely decorative, not sole identifier
WCAG AA contrast maintained for all text over gradient

keyFinding: Hero gradient is already implemented in current codebase with correct opacity (0F hex = 5.9%) and fade (60%). Story requires verification and E2E test coverage rather than new implementation.
